name: hypo-workflow
description: Manifest-based project delivery, durable memory, recovery, and controlled execution for coding agents.

interface.shortDescription: Durable Goal and Cycle delivery with project memory and recovery.
interface.longDescription: Hypo-Workflow gives coding agents a manifest-based project workspace with bounded Goal and Cycle delivery, ambient project memory, restart-safe recovery, explicit human acceptance, and Receipt-backed control for destructive operations.
defaultPrompt: Define and run one bounded delivery Goal.
